title: Eating Dumplings for the Winter Solstice
synopsis: Learn about the origin of Chinese dumplings.

fullText.simplified:
冬至为什么吃饺子？

    冬至，是中国的一个重要节气，也是中华民族的传统节日之一。民间有“冬至大如年”的说法。
    古人认为，冬至以后，白昼渐长，是一个节气循环的开始，也是一个吉日，应该庆贺。在中国北方，自古就有冬至吃饺子的传统，而这个传统和一个故事有关。
    汉朝时，有个很有名的医生叫张仲景。他治病的水平非常高，大家都叫他“神医”。有一年冬天，在回家的路上，他看到很多穷人面黄肌瘦，饥寒交迫，很多人的耳朵都冻伤了。他心里十分难受，就想了一个办法帮助那些穷人。
    冬至那天，他做了一种“祛寒娇耳汤”，送给穷人们喝，用来治疗耳朵的冻伤。这种汤是用羊肉、辣椒和一些能让人暖和起来的药材煮成的。除了汤，他还把羊肉和药材做成馅儿，用面皮包成耳朵的样子，称作“娇耳”，煮熟了分给大家吃。大家喝了汤、吃了“娇耳”以后，都觉得全身发暖，两耳发热，冻伤的耳朵也慢慢好了。
    冬至过后，天气会越来越冷，人们的耳朵很容易冻伤。所以从那以后，每到冬至这一天，人们就模仿这位神医的做法，按照他的方法煮热汤、做娇耳，时间长了就成了一种习惯。后来有人把“娇耳”称作“饺子”，至今，仍有“冬至吃饺子，不会冻掉耳朵”的说法。
    当然，现在冬至的美食也不只有饺子。在中国南方，人们的冬至食谱各不相同。上海人在冬至这一天习惯吃汤圆，南京人冬至必喝鸡汤，杭州人冬至一日三餐吃年糕，合肥人有冬至吃面条的习俗……其实不管冬至这天吃什么，最重要的是回到父母身边，回归家庭之中，享受冬日团圆的温暖。
fullText.traditional:
冬至為什麼吃餃子？

    冬至，是中國的一個重要節氣，也是中華民族的傳統節日之一。民間有“冬至大如年”的說法。
    古人認為，冬至以後，白晝漸長，是一個節氣循環的開始，也是一個吉日，應該慶賀。在中國北方，自古就有冬至吃餃子的傳統，而這個傳統和一個故事有關。
    漢朝時，有個很有名的醫生叫張仲景。他治病的水平非常高，大家都叫他“神醫”。有一年冬天，在回家的路上，他看到很多窮人面黃肌瘦，飢寒交迫，很多人的耳朵都凍傷了。他心裡十分難受，就想了一個辦法幫助那些窮人。
    冬至那天，他做了一種“祛寒嬌耳湯”，送給窮人們喝，用來治療耳朵的凍傷。這種湯是用羊肉、辣椒和一些能讓人暖和起來的藥材煮成的。除了湯，他還把羊肉和藥材做成餡兒，用麵皮包成耳朵的樣子，稱作“嬌耳”，煮熟了分給大家吃。大家喝了湯、吃了“嬌耳”以後，都覺得全身發暖，兩耳發熱，凍傷的耳朵也慢慢好了。
    冬至過後，天氣會越來越冷，人們的耳朵很容易凍傷。所以從那以後，每到冬至這一天，人們就模仿這位神醫的做法，按照他的方法煮熱湯、做嬌耳，時間長了就成了一種習慣。後來有人把“嬌耳”稱作“餃子”，至今，仍有“冬至吃餃子，不會凍掉耳朵”的說法。
    當然，現在冬至的美食也不只有餃子。在中國南方，人們的冬至食譜各不相同。上海人在冬至這一天習慣吃湯圓，南京人冬至必喝雞湯，杭州人冬至一日三餐吃年糕，合肥人有冬至吃麵條的習俗……其實不管冬至這天吃什麼，最重要的是回到父母身邊，回歸家庭之中，享受冬日團圓的溫暖。

sentences.english: Why Do We Eat Dumplings During the Winter Solstice?

sentences.simplified: 冬至，是中国的一个重要节气，也是中华民族的传统节日之一。
sentences.traditional: 冬至，是中國的一個重要節氣，也是中華民族的傳統節日之一。
sentences.pinyin: dōng zhì shì zhōng guó de yí ge zhòng yào jié qi yě shì zhōng huá mín zú de chuán tǒng jié rì zhī yī

sentences.simplified: 民间有“冬至大如年”的说法。
sentences.traditional: 民間有“冬至大如年”的說法。
sentences.pinyin: mín jiān yǒu dōng zhì dà rú nián de shuō fǎ
sentences.english: The winter solstice is a very important solar term in China, and it is also a traditional holiday of the Chinese people.
Among the people there is the saying, “the winter solstice is as important as the new year.”

sentences.simplified: 古人认为，冬至以后，白昼渐长，
sentences.traditional: 古人認為，冬至以後，白晝漸長，
sentences.pinyin: gǔ rén rèn wéi dōng zhì yǐ hòu bái zhòu jiàn cháng

sentences.simplified: 是一个节气循环的开始，也是一个吉日，应该庆贺。
sentences.traditional: 是一個節氣循環的開始，也是一個吉日，應該慶賀。
sentences.pinyin: shì yí ge jié qi xún huán de kāi shǐ yě shì yí ge jí rì yīng gāi qìng hè
sentences.english: The ancient people believed that after the winter solstice, the days become longer.

sentences.simplified: 在中国北方，自古就有冬至吃饺子的传统，
sentences.traditional: 在中國北方，自古就有冬至吃餃子的傳統，
sentences.pinyin: zài zhōng guó běi fāng zì gǔ jiù yǒu dōng zhì chī jiǎo zi de chuán tǒng
sentences.english: They believed that it was the start of a cycle of solar terms, as well as a lucky day, and that it should be celebrated.

sentences.simplified: 而这个传统和一个故事有关。
sentences.traditional: 而這個傳統和一個故事有關。
sentences.pinyin: ér zhè ge chuán tǒng hé yí ge gù shi yǒu guān
sentences.english: In northern China, the tradition of eating dumplings for the winter solstice has existed since ancient times.
This tradition has to do with a story.

sentences.simplified: 汉朝时，有个很有名的医生叫张仲景。
sentences.traditional: 漢朝時，有個很有名的醫生叫張仲景。
sentences.pinyin: hàn cháo shí yǒu ge hěn yǒu míng de yī shēng jiào zhāng zhòng jǐng

sentences.simplified: 他治病的水平非常高，大家都叫他“神医”。
sentences.traditional: 他治病的水平非常高，大家都叫他“神醫”。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhì bìng de shuǐ píng fēi cháng gāo dà jiā dōu jiào tā shén yī
sentences.english: During the Han Dynasty, there was a very famous doctor named Zhang Zhongjing.

sentences.simplified: 有一年冬天，在回家的路上，他看到很多穷人面黄肌瘦，饥寒交迫，
sentences.traditional: 有一年冬天，在回家的路上，他看到很多窮人面黃肌瘦，飢寒交迫，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì nián dōng tiān zài huí jiā de lù shang tā kàn dào hěn duō qióng rén miàn huáng jī shòu jī hán jiāo pò
sentences.english: He was very good at curing disease, so everyone called him the “miracle doctor”.

sentences.simplified: 很多人的耳朵都冻伤了。
sentences.traditional: 很多人的耳朵都凍傷了。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén de ěr duo dōu dòng shāng le
sentences.english: One winter, on the way home he saw many poor people who looked malnourished and sickly, suffering from both hunger and cold.

sentences.simplified: 他心里十分难受，就想了一个办法帮助那些穷人。
sentences.traditional: 他心裡十分難受，就想了一個辦法幫助那些窮人。
sentences.pinyin: tā xīn lǐ shí fēn nán shòu jiù xiǎng le yí ge bàn fǎ bāng zhù nà xiē qióng rén
sentences.english: Many of them had frostbitten ears.
He felt very bad, so he thought of something that could help those poor people.

sentences.simplified: 冬至那天，他做了一种“祛寒娇耳汤”，送给穷人们喝，
sentences.traditional: 冬至那天，他做了一種“祛寒嬌耳湯”，送給窮人們喝，
sentences.pinyin: dōng zhì nà tiān tā zuò le yì zhǒng qū hán jiāo ěr tāng sòng gěi qióng rén men hē

sentences.simplified: 用来治疗耳朵的冻伤。
sentences.traditional: 用來治療耳朵的凍傷。
sentences.pinyin: yòng lái zhì liáo ěr duo de dòng shāng
sentences.english: On the day of the winter solstice, he made a type of “cold-dispelling delicate ear soup” and gave it to the poor people to drink, ..

sentences.simplified: 这种汤是用羊肉、辣椒和一些能让人暖和起来的药材煮成的。
sentences.traditional: 這種湯是用羊肉、辣椒和一些能讓人暖和起來的藥材煮成的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng tāng shì yòng yáng ròu là jiāo hé yì xiē néng ràng rén nuǎn huo qǐ lái de yào cái zhǔ chéng de
sentences.english: .. in order to heal the frostbite on their ears.

sentences.simplified: 除了汤，他还把羊肉和药材做成馅儿，用面皮包成耳朵的样子，
sentences.traditional: 除了湯，他還把羊肉和藥材做成餡兒，用麵皮包成耳朵的樣子，
sentences.pinyin: chú le tāng tā hái bǎ yáng ròu hé yào cái zuò chéng xiàn'r yòng miàn pí bāo chéng ěr duo de yàng zi
sentences.english: This type of soup is made from lamb, peppers, and some warming medicinal herbs.

sentences.simplified: 称作“娇耳”，煮熟了分给大家吃。
sentences.traditional: 稱作“嬌耳”，煮熟了分給大家吃。
sentences.pinyin: chēng zuò jiāo ěr zhǔ shóu le fēn gěi dà jiā chī
sentences.english: Besides the soup, he also made the lamb and herbs into a filling, and wrapped into the shape of an ear using dough.

sentences.simplified: 大家喝了汤、吃了“娇耳”以后，都觉得全身发暖，两耳发热，
sentences.traditional: 大家喝了湯、吃了“嬌耳”以後，都覺得全身發暖，兩耳發熱，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā hē le tāng chī le jiāo ěr yǐ hòu dōu jué de quán shēn fā nuǎn liǎng ěr fā rè
sentences.english: He called them “delicate ears”, cooked them, and shared them with everyone.

sentences.simplified: 冻伤的耳朵也慢慢好了。
sentences.traditional: 凍傷的耳朵也慢慢好了。
sentences.pinyin: dòng shāng de ěr duo yě màn man hǎo le
sentences.english: After everyone drank the soup and ate the “delicate ears”, they felt their whole body warm up and their ears heat up.
Their frostbitten ears also slowly began to recover.

sentences.simplified: 冬至过后，天气会越来越冷，人们的耳朵很容易冻伤。
sentences.traditional: 冬至過後，天氣會越來越冷，人們的耳朵很容易凍傷。
sentences.pinyin: dōng zhì guò hòu tiān qì huì yuè lái yuè lěng rén men de ěr duo hěn róng yì dòng shāng

sentences.simplified: 所以从那以后，每到冬至这一天，人们就模仿这位神医的做法，
sentences.traditional: 所以從那以後，每到冬至這一天，人們就模仿這位神醫的做法，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ cóng nà yǐ hòu měi dào dōng zhì zhè yì tiān rén men jiù mó fǎng zhè wèi shén yī de zuò fǎ
sentences.english: After the winter solstice, the weather gets colder and colder, and people’s ears get frostbitten more easily.

sentences.simplified: 按照他的方法煮热汤、做娇耳，
sentences.traditional: 按照他的方法煮熱湯、做嬌耳，
sentences.pinyin: àn zhào tā de fāng fǎ zhǔ rè tāng zuò jiāo ěr
sentences.english: So from then on, every winter solstice people would copy the ways of this miracle doctor, ..

sentences.simplified: 时间长了就成了一种习惯。
sentences.traditional: 時間長了就成了一種習慣。
sentences.pinyin: shí jiān cháng le jiù chéng le yì zhǒng xí guàn
sentences.english: .. using his method to make soup and “delicate ears”.

sentences.simplified: 后来有人把“娇耳”称作“饺子”，
sentences.traditional: 後來有人把“嬌耳”稱作“餃子”，
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái yǒu rén bǎ jiāo ěr chēng zuò jiǎo zi
sentences.english: After some time, this turned into a custom.

sentences.simplified: 至今，仍有“冬至吃饺子，不会冻掉耳朵”的说法。
sentences.traditional: 至今，仍有“冬至吃餃子，不會凍掉耳朵”的說法。
sentences.pinyin: zhì jīn réng yǒu dōng zhì chī jiǎo zi bú huì dòng diào ěr duo de shuō fǎ
sentences.english: Later, people called the “delicate ears” dumplings.
And to this day there is still the saying, “eat dumplings on the winter solstice and your ears won’t freeze off”.

sentences.simplified: 当然，现在冬至的美食也不只有饺子。
sentences.traditional: 當然，現在冬至的美食也不只有餃子。
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán xiàn zài dōng zhì de měi shí yě bù zhǐ yǒu jiǎo zi

sentences.simplified: 在中国南方，人们的冬至食谱各不相同。
sentences.traditional: 在中國南方，人們的冬至食譜各不相同。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhōng guó nán fāng rén men de dōng zhì shí pǔ gè bù xiāng tóng
sentences.english: Of course, now the delicacies eaten during the winter solstice include more than just dumplings.

sentences.simplified: 上海人在冬至这一天习惯吃汤圆，
sentences.traditional: 上海人在冬至這一天習慣吃湯圓，
sentences.pinyin: shàng hǎi rén zài dōng zhì zhè yì tiān xí guàn chī tāng yuán
sentences.english: People from southern China have different winter solstice recipes that have nothing in common with each other.

sentences.simplified: 南京人冬至必喝鸡汤，
sentences.traditional: 南京人冬至必喝雞湯，
sentences.pinyin: nán jīng rén dōng zhì bì hē jī tāng
sentences.english: People from Shanghai are accustomed to eating glutinous rice balls during the winter solstice.

sentences.simplified: 杭州人冬至一日三餐吃年糕，
sentences.traditional: 杭州人冬至一日三餐吃年糕，
sentences.pinyin: háng zhōu rén dōng zhì yí rì sān cān chī nián gāo
sentences.english: People from Nanjing must eat chicken soup during the winter solstice.

sentences.simplified: 合肥人有冬至吃面条的习俗……
sentences.traditional: 合肥人有冬至吃麵條的習俗……
sentences.pinyin: hé féi rén yǒu dōng zhì chī miàn tiáo de xí sú
sentences.english: People from Hangzhou eat rice cake three meals a day during the winter solstice.

sentences.simplified: 其实不管冬至这天吃什么，
sentences.traditional: 其實不管冬至這天吃什麼，
sentences.pinyin: qí shí bù guǎn dōng zhì zhè tiān chī shén me
sentences.english: People from Hefei have the tradition of eating noodles during the winter solstice….

sentences.simplified: 最重要的是回到父母身边，回归家庭之中，
sentences.traditional: 最重要的是回到父母身邊，回歸家庭之中，
sentences.pinyin: zuì zhòng yào de shì huí dào fù mǔ shēn biān huí guī jiā tíng zhī zhōng
sentences.english: Actually, regardless of what you eat on the day of the winter solstice, ..

sentences.simplified: 享受冬日团圆的温暖。
sentences.traditional: 享受冬日團圓的溫暖。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng shòu dōng rì tuán yuán de wēn nuǎn
sentences.english: .. the most important thing is to return to your parents’ side, come home to your family, ..
.. and enjoy the warmth of reunion in the winter.

raw.synopsis: Learn about the origin of Chinese dumplings.
sentence_translations: Why Do We Eat Dumplings During the Winter Solstice?
The winter solstice is a very important solar term in China, and it is also a traditional holiday of the Chinese people.
Among the people there is the saying, “the winter solstice is as important as the new year.”
The ancient people believed that after the winter solstice, the days become longer.
They believed that it was the start of a cycle of solar terms, as well as a lucky day, and that it should be celebrated.
In northern China, the tradition of eating dumplings for the winter solstice has existed since ancient times.
This tradition has to do with a story.
During the Han Dynasty, there was a very famous doctor named Zhang Zhongjing.
He was very good at curing disease, so everyone called him the “miracle doctor”.
One winter, on the way home he saw many poor people who looked malnourished and sickly, suffering from both hunger and cold.
Many of them had frostbitten ears.
He felt very bad, so he thought of something that could help those poor people.
On the day of the winter solstice, he made a type of “cold-dispelling delicate ear soup” and gave it to the poor people to drink, ..
.. in order to heal the frostbite on their ears.
This type of soup is made from lamb, peppers, and some warming medicinal herbs.
Besides the soup, he also made the lamb and herbs into a filling, and wrapped into the shape of an ear using dough.
He called them “delicate ears”, cooked them, and shared them with everyone.
After everyone drank the soup and ate the “delicate ears”, they felt their whole body warm up and their ears heat up.
Their frostbitten ears also slowly began to recover.
After the winter solstice, the weather gets colder and colder, and people’s ears get frostbitten more easily.
So from then on, every winter solstice people would copy the ways of this miracle doctor, ..
.. using his method to make soup and “delicate ears”.
After some time, this turned into a custom.
Later, people called the “delicate ears” dumplings.
And to this day there is still the saying, “eat dumplings on the winter solstice and your ears won’t freeze off”.
Of course, now the delicacies eaten during the winter solstice include more than just dumplings.
People from southern China have different winter solstice recipes that have nothing in common with each other.
People from Shanghai are accustomed to eating glutinous rice balls during the winter solstice.
People from Nanjing must eat chicken soup during the winter solstice.
People from Hangzhou eat rice cake three meals a day during the winter solstice.
People from Hefei have the tradition of eating noodles during the winter solstice….
Actually, regardless of what you eat on the day of the winter solstice, ..
.. the most important thing is to return to your parents’ side, come home to your family, ..
.. and enjoy the warmth of reunion in the winter.
